name: A Very MADRA Christmas Launch
description: MADRA, the Connemara dog rescue, launches its Christmas range at Petmania Wellpark: bring your dog for a seasonal pup cup and festive photos, and pick up the MADRA calendar.

name: Santa Paws at The Kingsley
description: Bring your dog to meet Santa at The Kingsley by the River Lee, with a professional photo by Ted Murphy.
note: Sold out when checked; watch for returns.

name: Paws & Claus at Strokestown Park
description: A family day for dogs and their people at Strokestown Park, where pets are welcome around the grounds and in the Woodland Café (not in the house or museum).

name: Santa Paws at Dixiedoos Dog Grooming
description: Your dog meets Santa in a festive grotto, with a professional digital photo and a Christmas present; all ticket money goes to Dog Rescue Coolronan.
note: The ticket page lists more than one date; check it for other days.

name: Santa Paws at Newbridge House and Farm
time: Weekends from 28 Nov, plus Mon 21 and Tue 22 Dec; 10am to 4:30pm, book a time slot
description: Dogs meet Santa Paws in his grotto and get a small festive gift, with time to explore the grounds of Newbridge House; it usually sells out, so book early.

name: Santa Paws & Christmas Craft Fair
description: Christmas photos with Santa for your dog at the Milk Market, in aid of Deel Sighthound Rescue, with craft stalls and the canopy of lights.

name: Santa Paws at The Dirty Onion
description: Bring your dog to meet Santa and get a festive family photo, with music in the bar; all money goes to Assisi Animal Sanctuary.

name: NSPCA Christmas Quiz Night
description: Christmas table quiz in aid of the NSPCA at Pye, a dog-friendly pub in Dundrum village.
note: Found on an events listing site; check details with the NSPCA. Dogs are welcome in Pye's lounge on a lead.

name: Santa Paws at Siamsa Tíre
time: Sat 12, Sun 13, Sat 19 and Sun 20 Dec, 9am to 12pm
price: "Me & My Dog" €27; families: Santa ticket plus €15 per dog (book via box office)
description: Dedicated dog sessions with Santa at the national folk theatre in Tralee; every dog gets a Petmania goody bag and a photo with Santa.
note: Dogs on a lead and never left alone; the largest size allowed is a standard Labrador, and some breeds cannot be catered for.

name: Belfast Dog Show Society Championship Show
time: Sat: hound, terrier and gundog; Sun: utility, toy, working and pastoral
description: Ireland's largest championship dog show, the only all-breed show here under Kennel Club rules and a qualifier for Crufts, with all rings and trade stands under one roof.
note: At most championship shows only dogs entered for the show are allowed on site; check with the organisers before bringing another dog.
